title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary reunites with a British officer he once shared a bond with. Together, they set aside differences to fight despotic rulers, forging an inspiring path to freedom.

title: Shakti The Power
desc: Shekhar and Nandini visit his ancestral home in a rural Indian town, but things go wrong when they get caught in a violent feud and struggle to find a way back to Canada.

title: Krantiveer
desc: Pratap, disowned by his parents, finds himself in a small village ruled by gangsters and corrupt politicians. He faces tough challenges as he tries to navigate this dangerous world.

title: Runway 34
desc: Two pilots make a risky landing in Thiruvananthapuram due to bad weather. Trouble begins when aviation authorities investigate the incident, uncovering deeper issues.

desc: Don, a gangster, dies during a police chase. Vijay, Don's lookalike, infiltrates his gang on DSP D'Silva's orders to gather information but a change of events lands him in trouble.

title: Great Grand Masti
desc: Three friends meet Ragini in a small town. Her beauty charms them, but soon they realise she brings danger, mystery, and trouble into their lives.

title: Uri - The Surgical Strike
desc: After a deadly terrorist attack in Uri, Major Vihaan Singh Shergill leads a covert operation to eliminate the terrorists responsible, executing a high-risk mission deep across the border.

title: Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana
desc: Satyendra and Aarti fall in love through an arranged marriage. But when Aarti runs away on their wedding day, their lives take a painful and unexpected turn.

title: Khiladi
desc: Raj, Neelam, and Boney prank Sheetal's father with a fake kidnapping, but chaos ensues when Sheetal goes missing, putting them under suspicion and testing their innocence.

title: Hero No. 1
desc: A rich businessman hides his identity and pretends to be Raju, happily doing household chores. His skills and charm help him win over his girlfriend's family, all for love.

title: Dil Aashna Hai
desc: Laila, a cabaret dancer, embarks on a heartfelt quest to find her biological mother. Despite daunting obstacles, she pushes forward, supported at every step by her devoted lover, Karan.

title: Kalki 2898 AD
desc: In a ravaged world, a brave group races to protect a woman carrying Lord Vishnu's final avatar, Kalki, from Yaskin - the ruthless god-king bent on destroying her destiny.

desc: Ragini's viral video sparks buzz. A sleazy filmmaker sets his next horror movie in the same haunted house-only to stir the evil that still lurks in its shadows.

title: Apna Sapna Money Money
desc: Satyabol opposes his daughter Shivani's love for Arjun due to religious differences. Desperate to unite with her, Arjun seeks help from his cunning cousin Kishan, leading to twists.
